verdict.rationale: Dropbox's Dash surface has documented, published how-to pages for asking AI questions of files, summarizing, reviewing and organizing content (dash.dropbox.com/resources/*), which is more than an announcement. However, the main marketing page still frames AI as 'coming to Dropbox' and the AI capability is bundled in a separate Dash product rather than deeply integrated into core storage/API docs, with no independent hands-on corroboration of quality or reliability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification, technical API/developer docs for the AI features, and clearer evidence it's fully shipped (not partially rolled out) across the core product rather than just Dash.
